home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: This instance is under construction. Phase 0 delivers the foundation: processes, database, bootstrap and design system.
home.noRoles: No role has been assigned to you yet.
home.noAutomaticDataAccess: A role alone grants no access to analytics data. Access to a dashboard is granted separately through groups or direct grants.
home.nextMilestoneBody: Phase 1 – first vertical slice: project, Matomo connection, site, semantic metric, dashboard, widget, viewer.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email address and password.

setup.title: Set up the platform
setup.subtitle: Create the first platform administration account. This step is possible exactly once.
setup.tokenMissingBody: Open setup through the link printed by the bootstrap-admin command.
setup.tokenInvalidBody: The token is unknown, expired or already used. Generate a new one with bootstrap-admin.
setup.alreadyInitializedBody: This instance has already been initialized. The setup path is permanently closed. For administrative emergencies use the separate, audited recover-admin path.
setup.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Must not contain your name or the local part of your email address.
setup.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setup.successBody: The administration account has been created. You can sign in now.

recover.title: Restore administrative access
recover.subtitle: Break-glass procedure. Every use is audited.
recover.notice: This path restores platform administration access when none is left. It does not replace regular setup.
recover.successBody: The account holds platform administration rights again. All previous sessions of this account were revoked.

errors.genericAction: Please try again. If the problem persists, contact your administrator with the correlation id.
errors.unreachableAction: The application could not reach the API. Check that the API process is running.

auth.invalid_credentials: Email address or password is not correct.
auth.temporarily_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {retryAfterSeconds} seconds.
auth.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

bootstrap.already_initialized: This instance has already been initialized.
bootstrap.invalid_token: The activation token is invalid, expired or already used.
bootstrap.not_initialized: The platform is not initialized yet.

password.too_short: The password is too short. At least 12 characters.
